bullets.bullet_text: Led quantitative derivatives, variable-annuity hedging, and insurance-capital modeling initiatives, applying exotic pricing, liability Greeks, and higher-order stress testing to strengthen capital adequacy analysis for regulated clients.

Directed CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress testing programs, structuring traceable scenarios and challenger models alongside model-risk remediation to deliver audit-grade governance evidence for regulated financial institutions.

Architected enterprise risk management operating models aligned to BCBS 239, defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics across risk-data aggregation platforms.
